scope: Preferred-form source for the separate desktop Olaf CLI runtime, not a copy of the development checkout.

modifications: Added distribution-only .gitattributes enforcing LF; the 93 captured upstream package files are otherwise unchanged after CRLF normalization.
zigzag.package_limitation: The upstream packaged inventory omits examples/ and tests/ despite references in build.zig. Olaf consumes only the complete zigzag module; standalone Zigzag example/test build steps are not supported by this package.

normalization: All copied files are UTF-8 text. CRLF is normalized to LF only; no code is taken from prebuilt binaries. captured_sha256 hashes exact working bytes, source_lf_sha256 hashes captured text after LF normalization, sha256 hashes final distributed bytes. Upstream/fork hashes also use LF. File modes are not preserved (no executable scripts are needed by the supported Python/Zig entry point).
excluded_categories: Toolchains, caches, zig-pkg caches (except reviewed Zigzag source), zig-out and other build outputs
All audio including tests/16k_samples.raw and wasm/1051039_34s-54s.mp3; downloaded datasets
Precompiled WASM and bundled libsamplerate.worklet.js (contains precompiled third-party WASM)
Runtime databases, indexes, evidence, diagnostics, credentials and personal settings
Embedded ESP32 projects, demo-only web assets, evaluation tools/results, CI/container files and non-build documentation outside the desktop source scope
retained_source_assets: CLI configuration example/schema and embedded UI HTML
tests/golden/output_snapshot.txt: anonymized expected output; also a non-audio input to config safety regressions
src/olaf_fp_ref_mem.h: upstream 210-entry C fingerprint fixture required to compile the memory backend for config tests; not a user index, audio recording or desktop runtime database
WASM loader, Node test and package.json required by retained functional-test source
Python wrapper source/build metadata for the dataset-free constructor regression; not installed or used by the desktop build

modifications.summary: Windows LMDB filename suffixes; sole source change between public base and fork commit.
Complete captured working matcher/config/DB changes and new test; no extraction/index format change, but C config ABI changes.
Local Zigzag path; packaging source inventory; opt-in audio suite with no automatic downloads; explicit missing-fixture errors; release test documentation and synthetic legacy test path.
Build-only compiler privacy: module debug suppression and generated C file/macro/debug prefix-map response inputs for runtime and regression artifacts; no application engine changes.
Set stripping before install-step registration so Windows release installation does not request a suppressed PDB (2026-10-31); build-only fix.

build.native_validation: Not compiled or executed during source vendoring; all four target builds unverified. Source-only tests and mocked output checks are not native test results.
build.privacy_validation: Static/mocked Python validation only; actual Zig/Rust/native C response-file handling and all four target rebuilds remain unverified.

privacy_compiler_source.review: Version-specific interfaces and file hashes documented in docs/BUILD_PRIVACY.md; source archive inspected without executing a compiler.

hash_scope: Final sha256 values cover UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF, including source, notices, build helper, tests and ordered patches. PROVENANCE.json excludes itself to avoid recursive hashing. Runtime BUILD-INFO.json separately hashes the source manifest and actual binary.
licensing_review_remaining: Final application/combined-distribution and AGPL network-service obligations; process separation is not a blanket exemption.
External FFmpeg/FFprobe if a release bundles them.
Binary-specific toolchain/CRT/system-library subcomponent notices and SDK obligations; included Zig/mingw/musl notice files do not certify every emitted component.
Upstream patent warning is not resolved by source vendoring.
source_completeness_limits: The complete desktop build module closure is included; standard C/Zig headers are supplied by Zig 0.16.0.
Zigzag standalone examples/tests are absent from its original published package and are not part of the Olaf module dependency.
The optional ALLOC_TESTING c-algorithms harness header alloc-testing.h is absent from original Olaf and is not enabled in supported builds.
Audio/dataset and browser demo assets listed in exclusions are not source-only test passes; the full test suite is disabled by default.
